release_notes: Keitaro-parity release. Campaign editor: the dead '+' buttons next to the group and traffic-source selects now open quick-create dialogs, so a Facebook source can be instantiated from a template right inside the editor instead of being unselectable; picking a traffic source auto-fills the campaign's URL parameters (ad_id={{ad.id}}... ) exactly like Keitaro does, parameters persist across save/reopen (new campaigns.parameters_json), and the campaign link plus Keitaro-style link/iframe/script integration snippets are copyable from the Integrations tab. New TikTok Ads cost engine (Aggregators, engine 'tiktok') with the same click-matching as the Facebook one. New inbound endpoint POST /admin_api/v1/campaigns/{id}/update_costs, wire-compatible with Keitaro Admin API v1, so Dolphin and Fbtool.pro can push Facebook spend straight into Orbitra - filters match click parameters with the Keitaro sub_id_3/sub_id_4 defaults, spend is currency-converted and split across matched clicks, unmatched amounts are parked for audit. Keitaro migration: imported traffic sources now get their parameters normalized into Orbitra's format (previously the raw serialized blob silently broke parameter capture and cost matching), and landing groups are imported with landings attached. GroupsModal follows the theme (dark themes fixed), groups of every type can be deleted, and the dead 'Groups'/'Sources' buttons on the Campaigns/Landings/Offer editor pages are wired up. New strings translated in all seven locales.
